critical_limits: Nonflasqueness is not a counterexample to derived descent.
The coefficientwise closure example permits correcting boundary-supported components.
Degreewise sheaf gluing is not hypercohomological descent.
Later ordinary Rost-Schmid representability does not identify the BLRS splice.
Finite code controls do not calculate arbitrary Milnor-Witt complexes.
Imported foundational purity and Rost-Schmid results are not re-proved.
No literature-wide openness or novelty certificate.
optional_clarifications: When expanding the monograph summary, state the infinite-perfect-field hypothesis of Chapter 3 Corollary 3.2.13.
remaining_gap: For general smooth separated finite-type X over a perfect field of characteristic not 2 and q>0, prove the lower-part augmented finite Cech defect acyclic, or exhibit a genuine nonzero class.
verdict_scope: Independent review of a deliberately unresolved five-approach packet, not a full resolution of BLRS descent.
